panel.name: backgrounds_panel
panel.string: Choose a texture or enter its UUID.
An image is already being imported.
Display arrangement changed. Using the common background until reassigned.

panel.name: background_editor
panel.text: Backgrounds fill the spare workspace outside your world viewport.

check_box.name: background_inherit
check_box.label: Use default background
check_box.tool_tip: Changing the default updates every workspace that inherits it.

workspace_background_diagram.name: background_preview
workspace_background_diagram.tool_tip: Click a display to customize it. The shaded region is your world viewport.

button.name: background_reassign
button.label: Reassign saved displays
button.tool_tip: Apply the saved display overrides to the current arrangement, ordered left to right.

color_swatch.name: background_color
color_swatch.label: Background color
color_swatch.tool_tip: Also fills unused space in Fit and Center modes.

line_editor.name: background_uuid
line_editor.tool_tip: Texture asset UUID on the current grid.

button.name: background_file
button.label: Choose image / Locate replacement…
button.tool_tip: Imports a copy into your profile. The original can be moved or deleted.

combo_box.name: background_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: Fill crops; Fit preserves the entire image. Span fills continuously across displays and suspends their overrides.

button.name: background_reset
button.label: Reset to default
button.tool_tip: This workspace inherits the default. When editing the shared default, restore its original solid color.
